page.overview:
What is Svarr?

A Svarr, literally meaning "mist-ship," is a boat that uses the buoyancy of Island Clouds to sail through the air. They are used to move around Elbaph's Sun World.

As they are designed for use by giants, Svarrs are very large, with one easily having enough space to carry the Thousand Sunny. They are propelled using oars that end in Island Clouds, on which the ships float. Notably, they cannot be used in Elbaph's Underworld, as the Island Clouds disappear upon entry. Normal ships, such as the Great Eirik, can be converted into Svarrs by adding Island Clouds to their oars.

Svarrs share a Viking theme with the rest of Elbaph, with shields along the side of the ship and a single striped sail. They have three oars to either side. In addition, certain models exist for fire-fighting, with one model in particular bearing a solid-color design, multiple ladders, a hose connected to a large bag of water, and a bell.

The New Giant Warrior Pirates used a Svarr to transport the Straw Hat Pirates from the Western Village to the Owl Library. They later used the same Svarr to return to the Western Village and begin their banquet.
